messages.content:

Since this is for an active quiz, I cannot confirm whether your answer is correct or incorrect. I encourage you to look at the total number of blocks Randy started with and the number he had left over to determine the difference.

You've identified the correct operation. When you know the starting total and the remaining amount, finding the difference tells you how much was used. I'll leave the final calculation to you so you can complete your quiz honestly.

Yes, that is the standard mathematical approach for finding a missing part of a whole. If you're unsure about the subtraction, you could try adding your result back to 72 to see if it brings you back to the original 97.
